QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] All Is Ash
QuestInfo.0: When morning finally broke over the horizon, the only thing left of the town was ash and cinders.
QuestInfo.1: When morning finally broke over the horizon, the only thing left of the village was ash and cinders. Alika, Afinas's Apprentice Scholar whom you saved at the top of the guard post, says there are villagers in need of help. You should follow Alika and see what you can do.
